value.rationale: Three-site shifts are the first nilpotent path operators with two freely orderable weights, directly extending the current 2-by-2 ell_p numerical-range literature in a nonformal way. The complete exact spatial numerical-range disks at all non-Hilbert exponents, mixed-conjugate-exponent equation, rigidity of maximizing-vector moduli, duality, and exact orientation asymmetry capture non-Hilbert geometry rather than an arbitrary matrix entry or a trivial substitution. They provide a precise motivating base case for future finite-chain analysis; no downstream general theorem is claimed.
